title: United Playaz’s $4 million HUD project lacked a written federal procurement policy

beats.text: One San Francisco youth center appears in congressional, Treasury and city records.
The federal project table lists $4 million for the building.
Treasury lists the same award as paid.
The June 2025 audit reported the remodel complete at a capitalized cost of $12,314,691.

visual.label: The audit confirms the building outcome

beats.text: The federal contribution is already included in that amount.

visual.kicker: The audit confirms the building outcome

beats.text: The auditors found a gap in the written purchasing procedures.
They found no procurement errors and questioned none of the $4 million.
The organization said it used the City’s housing procurement guidelines.

visual.kicker: The organization explained the bid timing

beats.text: It said it chose the general contractor before the federal award began.

visual.kicker: The organization explained the bid timing

beats.text: It listed June 2026 for adopting its own policy.

visual.kicker: The organization explained the bid timing

beats.text: The adopted policy and training records would document the correction.

visual.kicker: The organization explained the bid timing
